Message from Lumo :
I don’t have a single “full shipping policy” page I can link you to here, but I can share the shipping details I have. 
Standard Daytime Delivery (typical shipping process)
Order confirmation email is sent after you place your order.
Orders placed before 1:00 pm ET/MT should leave our warehouses the same day, Monday to Sunday, excluding holidays.
Orders placed after 1:00 pm ET/MT should leave our warehouses the next business day.
Once your order is with the courier, we provide a tracking number.
If your order has multiple items, items may arrive on different days and each item will have its own tracking number.
Delivery attempts are between 9am–7pm for residential addresses.
Full-Service Delivery (Canada only; select cities; $99 + tax)
Available in select Canadian cities (e.g., Toronto, Vancouver, Edmonton, Calgary, Halifax, Moncton); eligibility and fees are determined at checkout.
Available for mattresses, furniture, pillows, mattress protectors, and select accessories.
Appointments are typically scheduled within four weeks of purchase.
Includes delivery to room of choice, assembly, and removal of packaging; old mattress/box spring removal is limited to one per Endy mattress or bed frame purchased.
Canadian Territories shipping
We can only ship to Iqaluit, Whitehorse, and Yellowknife.
Mattress orders incur a $150 shipping fee; bedding-only orders ship free.
Product size/category restrictions apply (e.g., no King/Cal King mattresses; no bed frames/headboards/sofas/ottomans/rugs).
If you tell me whether you’re in Canada or the US (and what you’re ordering), I can point you to the exact shipping details that apply to you.

turns.q: What's your warranty policy on defective items?
turns.replyTail: - Comfort preference or mattress height preference - Stains, burns, tears, cuts, or liquid/moisture damage - Damage from an inappropriate foundation - Products sold by an unauthorized retailer or sold as “used” (or similar wording) - For The Endy Hybrid Mattress only: damage to fabric handles from improper handling If a covered manufacturer defect is confirmed during the warranty period, we’ll offer a one-time replacement or repair of the original mattress size purchased (no fee or deductible).
turns.replyText:
Message from you:
What's your warranty policy on defective items?
Message from Lumo :
If you’re dealing with a defective Endy mattress purchased directly from Endy.com, it’s covered by a 10-year Limited Warranty by default, and you can extend it to a 15-year Limited Warranty at no additional cost by registering as an Endy VIP. 
What the Limited Warranty covers (normal wear and use): 
Degradation that causes a visible indentation greater than one (1) inch (not associated with an improper foundation)
Any physical flaw that causes the foam to split or crack despite normal usage and proper handling
For The Endy Mattress only: defects or flaws in the zipper assembly of the mattress cover (we may repair or replace the cover)
What it doesn’t cover: 
Normal increase in softness after long-term use
Comfort preference or mattress height preference
Stains, burns, tears, cuts, or liquid/moisture damage
Damage from an inappropriate foundation
Products sold by an unauthorized retailer or sold as “used” (or similar wording)
For The Endy Hybrid Mattress only: damage to fabric handles from improper handling
If a covered manufacturer defect is confirmed during the warranty period, we’ll offer a one-time replacement or repair of the original mattress size purchased (no fee or deductible).
